commands.name: new
commands.description: Start a new session (fresh session ID + history).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show session info, followed by a local Session recap block (recent turn counts, top tools used, files touched, latest prompt + reply).

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Kill all running background processes and interrupt the running agent.

commands.name: discard
commands.description: Drop a turn Hermes lost in a restart so this chat's queued messages run again.

commands.name: pause
commands.description: Global emergency stop, the in-chat form of `hermes pause`: puts new cron, kanban and gateway work on hold until `/pause off`.

commands.name: model
commands.description: Show or change the model.

commands.name: codex-runtime
commands.description: Toggle the optional Codex app-server runtime.

commands.name: personality
commands.description: Set a personality overlay for the session.

commands.name: fast
commands.description: Fast mode — OpenAI Priority Processing / Anthropic Fast Mode.

commands.name: retry
commands.description: Retry the last message.

commands.name: undo
commands.description: Remove the last exchange.

commands.name: sethome
commands.description: Mark the current chat as the platform home channel for deliveries.

commands.name: compress
commands.description: Manually compress conversation context.

commands.name: save
commands.description: Export the current session as JSON, Markdown, or HTML and send the file into the chat as a document.

commands.name: title
commands.description: Set or show the session title.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume a previously named session.

commands.name: sessions
commands.description: List previous sessions for this chat; the active session appears with a `(current)` marker.

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show token usage, estimated cost breakdown (input/output), context window state, session duration, and — when available from the active provider — an Account li

commands.name: topup
commands.description: Show your Nous balance and manage billing on the portal.

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Show your slash command access level (admin / user).

commands.name: insights
commands.description: Show usage analytics.

commands.name: reasoning
commands.description: Change reasoning effort (levels up to `max` / `ultra`) or toggle reasoning display (`full` / `clamp` included).

commands.name: voice
commands.description: Control spoken replies in chat.

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: List or restore filesystem checkpoints.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show git changes in the working directory (fenced and truncated to platform message limits).

commands.name: bg
commands.description: Run a prompt in a separate background session.

commands.name: btw
commands.description: Ask a side question about the current conversation without interrupting it.

commands.name: queue
commands.description: Queue a prompt for the next turn without interrupting the current one.

commands.name: steer
commands.description: Inject a message after the next tool call without interrupting — the model picks it up on its next iteration rather than as a new turn.

commands.name: goal
commands.description: Set a standing goal Hermes works toward across turns — our take on the Ralph loop.

commands.name: subgoal
commands.description: Append criteria to the active `/goal` mid-loop (`/subgoal`, `/subgoal remove <N>`, `/subgoal clear`).

commands.name: heartbeat
commands.description: Set a recurring prompt that re-enters this session when idle.

commands.name: loop
commands.description: Re-run a prompt on a recurring interval in this session.

commands.name: refine
commands.description: Run the memory/skill self-improvement review now, optionally with focus instructions.

commands.name: review
commands.description: Spawn an independent reviewer subagent for the work just discussed (PR, code, docs); its review re-enters this chat when done.

commands.name: moa
commands.description: Run one prompt through the default Mixture of Agents preset, then restore the session model.

commands.name: branch
commands.description: Branch the current session.

commands.name: agents
commands.description: Show active agents and running tasks.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Context-window usage gauge and category breakdown (messaging-friendly text form).

commands.name: egress
commands.description: Show Docker egress proxy status.

commands.name: init
commands.description: Generate or update `AGENTS.md` from a repo scan.

commands.name: learn
commands.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything you describe.

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Write a markdown implementation plan to `.hermes/plans/`; no execution.

commands.name: bundles
commands.description: List configured skill bundles (`/<name>` aliases that preload several skills).

commands.name: reload-skills
commands.description: Re-scan `~/.hermes/skills/` for newly installed or removed skills.

commands.name: footer
commands.description: Toggle the runtime-metadata footer on final replies (shows model, context %, and cwd).

commands.name: curator
commands.description: Background skill maintenance controls.

commands.name: suggestions
commands.description: Review suggested automations right in chat.

commands.name: blueprint
commands.description: Browse cron blueprints, start a guided slot-filling conversation, or create a blueprint job directly.

commands.name: memory
commands.description: Review pending memory writes staged by the write-approval gate (`memory.write_approval`) — approve or reject them right in chat — and toggle the gate with `/mem

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Review pending skill writes staged by the write-approval gate (`skills.write_approval`).

commands.name: kanban
commands.description: Drive the multi-profile, multi-project collaboration board from chat — identical argument surface to the CLI.

commands.name: platform
commands.description: Operate a running gateway platform right from chat.

commands.name: reload-mcp
commands.description: Reload MCP servers from config and re-probe tool availability.

commands.name: verbose
commands.description: Cycle tool progress display.

commands.name: yolo
commands.description: Toggle YOLO mode — skip all dangerous command approval prompts.

commands.name: commands
commands.description: Browse all commands and skills (paginated).

commands.name: approve
commands.description: Approve and execute a pending dangerous command.

commands.name: deny
commands.description: Reject a pending dangerous command.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update Hermes Agent to the latest version.

commands.name: restart
commands.description: Gracefully restart the gateway after draining active runs.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Upload debug report (system info + logs) and get shareable links.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Show messaging help.
